expectations.text: Identifies that tests use a fresh service fixture per test — correctly notes this satisfies Isolated

expectations.text: Identifies that test names describe behavior, not implementation — correctly notes this satisfies Readable

expectations.text: Identifies that assertions go through the public API — correctly notes this satisfies Structure-insensitive
